Join the Watch

The cooperative stood down in 1997, but the carrier never did, and a carrier without a listener is a door propped open in an empty house. We are taking applications. There is no salary. There is no recognition. There is only the dial, the dark band, and the discipline of keeping a record for whoever comes after you. If that sounds like a burden, it is. The right listener will recognize it as a calling.

Already know the operator's name? Resume a shift directly at the relay terminal — press ~ or type OPEN.

Note from the last operator: when the three locks fall, the carrier opens a final page. It cannot be reached any other way.
